changelog:
Linux version 4.9.337-DaisyForGaming (Proton clang 13.0.0, LTO)

- net: TCP BBR + FQ qdisc, runtime-switchable (Cubic stays default)
- block: BFQ scheduler (4.9 legacy split backport), set as default I/O scheduler
- security: KALLSYMS_HARDENED (masks addresses in /proc/kallsyms)
- fs: dynamic fsync toggle (/sys/kernel/dyn_fsync/dyn_fsync)
- power: gaming_charge sysfs toggle (FCC/vfloat cap, charger-present interlock, auto-restore on unplug)
- cpufreq: interactive governor fixes for 4.9.337
- version: 4.9.337, clean compiler string (no vendor git branding)
